# 🕶️ agent-blindfold ### *"Keep your AI Agent's eyes on the code, not on your private stash."* **Codename: `Heart-Under-Blade` (`刃下心`) · v1.2.0** [![CI](https://github.com/zanex-dev/agent-blindfold/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/zanex-dev/agent-blindfold/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-gold.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Antigravity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google_Antigravity-Native_Plugin_%26_Hook-4285F4.svg)](#quick-start--one-click-install) [![Claude Code](https://img.shields.io/badge/Claude_Code-SessionStart_%2B_PreToolUse-D97757.svg)](#quick-start--one-click-install) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Windows_%7C_macOS_%7C_Linux-success.svg)](#architecture--smart-4-tier-defense) **English** | [简体中文](./README_zh.md) · [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md)
### ✨ What's New in v1.2.0 (User-Scoped Grants & Fail-Closed Hardening) Workspace grants now live in the current user's private store (`~/.gemini/config/agent-blindfold-grants/`) and use the canonical workspace path as identity. Issuing, renewing, or revoking a grant never modifies project files or Git metadata—cleanly supporting regular repositories, linked worktrees, and submodules without dirtying `git status`. The Unix/Bash hooks require Python 3.9 or newer. They probe the active virtual environment, working executables on `PATH` (skipping empty WindowsApps alias stubs under Git Bash), and the Windows `py` launcher where available; a missing interpreter or malformed hook payload fails closed with a host-compatible blocking response. **Upgrading existing workspaces from v1.1.x:** Legacy in-project `.allow_media` files are now ignored and left intact so untrusted repositories cannot ship pre-unlocked passes. Review each workspace path and use the local controller (`unlock.ps1` / `unlock.sh` / `blindfold-control.cmd`) to reissue any manual timed or permanent grants you want to keep. Default `timed` policy still renews at each eligible session start; set `off` to require manual approval for each new grant. Existing local grants can be revoked individually, and an invalid policy file pauses new automatic issuance rather than falling back to auto-grant. Status output displays the effective settings for the current process along with their sources. --- ## ⚡ Why `agent-blindfold`? (Privacy & Anti-Ban Shield) Modern AI Coding Agents (**Google Antigravity**, **Claude Code**, etc.) are natively multimodal—whenever an agent invokes `read_file`, `Read`, or an MCP inspection tool on a local image, video, or audio file, the raw binary bytes are immediately uploaded to cloud multimodal endpoints. Relying solely on system prompts (`GEMINI.md` / `CLAUDE.md`) is a **gentleman's agreement**, not a security boundary: 1. **Irreversible Privacy Leakage**: During broad directory scans, parallel subagent exploration, or long-context attention decay, an agent can accidentally read personal photos, screen recordings, or cached chat media in `Pictures`, `Downloads`, `Desktop`, or `AppData`. Once transmitted to the cloud, it cannot be undone. 2. **False-Positive Account Bans (Anti-Ban Shield)**: Cloud safety classifiers automatically audit uploaded visual media. If an agent accidentally reads local anime illustrations (e.g., *Monogatari* / Oshino Shinobu artwork), game CGs, or private artwork on your disk, automated cloud moderation can flag your account and trigger an immediate, irreversible **account suspension**. **`agent-blindfold` (`Heart-Under-Blade / 刃下心`)** enforces **Dual-Layer Zero-Trust Protection** without blinding frontend/UI engineering: - **Layer 1 — Soft Prompt Discipline (`rules/AGENTS.md`)**: Instructs the agent upfront to skip personal/external binary media while permitting legitimate UI/frontend verification assets. - **Layer 2 — Host Tool-Call Guard (`SessionStart` + `PreToolUse` Hooks)**: Automatically grants **Timed (TTL)** or **Permanent** workspace passes at the start of engineering sessions, exempts UI sandboxes (`scratch`, `brain`, `.playwright-mcp`, `.svg`), and checks protected media paths and attempted policy changes before covered host tool calls. --- ## 🛡️ Architecture & Smart 4-Tier Defense ```mermaid flowchart TD S["SessionStart Hook
(session_start.ps1 / session_start.sh)"] --> S1{"Engineering Workspace?
(Skips Vaults & Read-Only Chat)"} S1 -- "Yes" --> S2["Issues user-owned workspace grant
(Timed Default 2h OR Permanent)
in private user state"] A["Agent invokes Tool
(read_file / Read / Write / MCP / run_command / Bash)"] --> T{"Anti-Tamper Guard:
Touches .allow_media / policy / unlock.*?"} T -- "Yes (Mutation / Exec)" --> DENYT["🚫 HARD DENY
(Blocks Agent Self-Unlock)"] T -- "No" --> C{"Touches Monitored Media?
(.jpg/.png/.webp/.heic/.mp4/.mp3...)"} C -- "No (Code / Web https:// / Workspace .svg)" --> ALLOW["✅ ALLOW / Neutral Pass-Through"] C -- "Yes" --> D{"Tier 1: In Hard Personal Vault?
(Pictures / Videos / Music / AppData
or Root Desktop / Downloads / Documents)"} D -- "Yes" --> DENY1["🚫 HARD DENY
(Permanently Locked)"] D -- "No" --> E0{"Tier 0: Engineering Sandbox?
(scratch/<app> / active brain/<id> / .playwright-mcp)"} E0 -- "Yes (Symlink-Verified)" --> ALLOW E0 -- "No" --> E{"Tier 2: Inside a Dedicated
Active Project Workspace?"} E -- "No (External Path / Sibling Leak)" --> DENY2["🚫 HARD DENY
(External Directory Isolation)"] E -- "Yes" --> F{"Tier 3: Valid local workspace grant?
(Permanent or Unexpired Timed TTL)"} F -- "No / Expired (Auto-Cleaned)" --> DENY3["🔒 DEFAULT DENY
(Blocks Read & Shell Byte-Dump;
Allows Safe Git Ops)"] F -- "Yes" --> ALLOW ``` ### Monitored Media Extensions - **Images**: `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png`, `.gif`, `.webp`, `.bmp`, `.ico`, `.heic`, `.heif`, `.avif` *(Note: plain-text `.svg` vector icons inside project workspaces and engineering sandboxes are exempted so frontend UI development is never disrupted; `.svg` inside personal vaults remains blocked).* - **Video**: `.mp4`, `.mkv`, `.avi`, `.mov`, `.webm`, `.flv`, `.wmv` - **Audio**: `.mp3`, `.wav`, `.flac`, `.m4a`, `.ogg`, `.aac` ### Smart Four-Tier Policy | Tier | Scope | Policy | Real-World Behavior | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Tier 1: Hard Personal Vaults** | `Pictures`, `Videos`, `Music`, `AppData`, plus root `Desktop`, `Downloads`, `Documents` | **Unconditional `deny`** | Permanently locked—even if `~/Downloads` itself is opened as a workspace or contains `.allow_media`. Evaluated **after** symlink/junction resolution. | | **Tier 0: Engineering Sandboxes** | `~/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/`, active `artifactDirectoryPath` (`brain/`), `/.playwright-mcp/` | **Auto-Exempt (`allow`)** | Keeps frontend/SVG/Playwright UI visual checks working seamlessly even when no Active Workspace is mounted, while blocking cross-session `.user_uploaded/` leaks. | | **Tier 2: External Directories** | Any path outside your active dedicated project workspace (`workspacePaths` / `cwd`) | **Unconditional `deny`** | Blocks cross-drive snooping, `../` traversals, symlinks, and sibling files in parent folders. | | **Tier 3: Dedicated Project Workspace** | Project assets inside a specific repo (including repos cloned under `~/Downloads/my-app` or `~/Desktop/my-app`) | **`SessionStart` Auto-Pass (`timed` / `permanent`) or Manual Pass** | Automatically receives a timed (`2h` default) or permanent local grant at session start (configurable to `off` for strict manual mode); expired passes auto-clean themselves. | ### Built-In Bypass & Anti-Tamper Hardening - **Anti-Tamper Guard (Zero Self-Unlock)**: Intercepts `write_file`, `edit_file`, `Write`, `Edit`, `MultiEdit`, MCP write tools, and terminal commands (`run_command` / `Bash`) so AI Agents can **never** create, edit, forge, or delete local grants (`agent-blindfold-grants/`), legacy `.allow_media` markers, `agent-blindfold.json`, or run `unlock.ps1` / `unlock.sh`. - **Shell / Terminal Guard (`run_command` & `Bash`)**: Blocks directory scans on `Pictures`/`Videos`/`Music`, blocks shell commands touching personal/external media, blocks command-chained `git` spoofing (`git status && base64 a.png`), and blocks content-encoding bypasses (`base64`, `certutil`, `xxd`, `PIL`, `cv2`, `ffmpeg`, `magick`, `tesseract`) on locked workspace media—without breaking `git status`, `git add`, or `git commit`. - **MCP & URI Normalization**: Inspects nested `call_mcp_tool` arguments (`markitdown`, `filesystem`, `playwright`), decodes percent-encoded `file://` URIs (`%20`), strips NTFS `::$DATA` streams, resolves symlinks, and ignores public `https://` web URLs. - **Zero Permission Hijacking on Claude Code**: Exits `0` with **empty `stdout`** when allowing a tool call or `SessionStart` event on Claude Code, deferring cleanly to Claude Code's native permission prompts. - **Windows `cmd /c` Clean Stream**: Writes raw UTF-8 (no BOM) bytes directly to `stdout` and uses quote-free invocation so Windows `CreateProcess` never corrupts `protojson` with `\"` escaping. --- ## 🚀 Quick Start & One-Click Install ### 1. Clone the Repository ```bash git clone https://github.com/zanex-dev/agent-blindfold.git cd agent-blindfold ``` ### 2. One-Click Global Install (Configurable Timed vs. Permanent Auto-Grant) By default, the installer enables **Timed (`2h`)** automatic exemption at `SessionStart` (`~/.gemini/config/agent-blindfold.json`), installs the **Google Antigravity** native plugin (`~/.gemini/config/plugins/agent-blindfold`), and losslessly merges `SessionStart` + `PreToolUse` hooks into **Claude Code** (`~/.claude/settings.json` with `.bak` backup): #### Windows (PowerShell) ```powershell # Default: Timed 2h auto-exemption at session start powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 # Optional: Permanent auto-exemption for engineering workspaces, or 'off' for manual-only powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 -AutoGrant permanent powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 -AutoGrant timed -DefaultTTL 4h ``` #### macOS / Linux (Bash) ```bash chmod +x ./install.sh ./scripts/*.sh ./install.sh # Optional: Permanent auto-exemption or custom TTL ./install.sh --auto-grant permanent ./install.sh --auto-grant timed --ttl 4h ``` ### 3. One-Click Clean Uninstall ```powershell # Windows powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 -Uninstall ``` ```bash # macOS / Linux ./install.sh --uninstall ``` ### 4. Live Toggle in Google Antigravity (Zero Restart) Because `agent-blindfold` ships as a native Antigravity plugin bundle, you can temporarily pause or resume all hooks & rules live—without uninstalling or restarting the app—via **Customizations → Plugins → Agent Blindfold** (or via chat link `customization://agent-blindfold`) whenever debugging or updating the firewall itself. --- ## 🔓 Timed vs. Permanent Workspace Passes (`unlock` CLI & Controller) You can switch global `SessionStart` policy or issue/revoke per-workspace passes at any time from your own terminal (or by double-clicking **`blindfold-control.cmd`** on Windows): ### Windows PowerShell (`scripts/unlock.ps1`) ```powershell # Grant a 2-hour timed pass (expires automatically; stored in the user profile) powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\unlock.ps1 -Mode timed -TTL 2h -Workspace C:\path\to\my-app # Grant a permanent pass to a trusted frontend project powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\unlock.ps1 -Mode permanent -Workspace C:\path\to\my-app # Check current workspace pass & global SessionStart policy powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\unlock.ps1 -Status -Workspace C:\path\to\my-app # Revoke pass immediately (re-lock workspace) powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\unlock.ps1 -Lock -Workspace C:\path\to\my-app # Switch global SessionStart auto-grant policy (timed | permanent | off) powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\unlock.ps1 -GlobalAutoGrant permanent ``` ### macOS / Linux (`scripts/unlock.sh`) ```bash ./scripts/unlock.sh --timed 2h --workspace /path/to/my-app ./scripts/unlock.sh --permanent --workspace /path/to/my-app ./scripts/unlock.sh --status --workspace /path/to/my-app ./scripts/unlock.sh --lock --workspace /path/to/my-app ./scripts/unlock.sh --global-auto-grant permanent ``` ### Rejection Message Language (`AGENT_BLINDFOLD_LANG`) By default, block reasons are emitted in concise **English + Chinese** (`bilingual`). Customize via environment variable: - `AGENT_BLINDFOLD_LANG=en` — English only - `AGENT_BLINDFOLD_LANG=zh` — Simplified Chinese only - `AGENT_BLINDFOLD_LANG=bilingual` — Default (`English | 中文`) --- ## 🧪 Running the Automated Test Suite `agent-blindfold` ships with zero-dependency cross-platform end-to-end security, local grant store, and sandboxed installer test suites (`tests/run_tests.py` and `tests/test_local_grants.py`): ```bash python tests/run_tests.py python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_local_grants.py -v ``` --- ## 📂 Repository Structure ```text agent-blindfold/ ├── .github/workflows/ │ └── ci.yml # Multi-OS GitHub Actions CI (Windows, Ubuntu, macOS) ├── assets/ │ └── shinobu-banner.svg # Project vector banner (Heart-Under-Blade) ├── docs/ │ └── v1.1-exemption-design.md # Historical v1.1 architecture & security specification ├── rules/ │ └── AGENTS.md # Layer 1 soft prompt media-isolation rule (Antigravity Plugin) ├── scripts/ │ ├── grant_store.ps1 # Windows user-scoped grant store, canonical path & locking helpers │ ├── grant_store.py # Cross-platform Python user-scoped grant store & policy helpers │ ├── guard.ps1 # Windows PowerShell PreToolUse firewall + Anti-Tamper Guard │ ├── guard.py # Cross-platform Python PreToolUse firewall + Anti-Tamper Guard │ ├── guard.sh # Unix Bash wrapper for guard.py with fail-closed fallback │ ├── session_start.ps1 # Windows SessionStart auto-exemption hook (timed / permanent) │ ├── session_start.py # Cross-platform Python SessionStart auto-exemption hook │ ├── session_start.sh # Unix Bash wrapper for session_start.py │ ├── unlock.ps1 # Windows pass issuer & global policy CLI / interactive wizard │ ├── unlock.py # Cross-platform Python pass issuer & global policy CLI │ ├── unlock.sh # Unix Bash wrapper for unlock.py │ ├── claude_settings.py # Surgical non-destructive Claude Code settings.json hook merger │ └── python_runtime.sh # Verified Python 3.9+ discovery helper (skips WindowsApps stubs) ├── tests/ │ ├── run_tests.py # Cross-platform E2E security, SessionStart & installer test suite │ └── test_local_grants.py # User-scoped grant store, fail-closed & host integration tests ├── blindfold-control.cmd # Windows one-click interactive exemption control launcher ├── .gitattributes # Enforces LF on .sh/.py and CRLF on .ps1/.cmd across checkouts ├── hooks.json # Native Antigravity SessionStart + PreToolUse hook manifest ├── plugin.json # Native Antigravity plugin manifest ├── install.ps1 # Windows idempotent installer & uninstaller ├── install.sh # macOS / Linux idempotent installer & uninstaller ├── SECURITY.md # Threat model & vulnerability reporting policy ├── CHANGELOG.md # Release history ├── CHANGELOG_zh.md # Simplified Chinese release history ├── README.md # English documentation ├── README_zh.md # Simplified Chinese documentation └── LICENSE # MIT License ``` --- ## 📜 License Released under the [MIT License](./LICENSE). `Copyright (c) 2026 琢玹 (zanex)`

# 🕶️ agent-blindfold ### *"Keep your AI Agent's eyes on the code, not on your private stash."* **项目代号：`Heart-Under-Blade` (`刃下心`) · v1.2.0** [![CI](https://github.com/zanex-dev/agent-blindfold/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/zanex-dev/agent-blindfold/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-gold.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Antigravity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google_Antigravity-原生插件与_Hook-4285F4.svg)](#快速开始与一键安装) [![Claude Code](https://img.shields.io/badge/Claude_Code-SessionStart_%2B_PreToolUse-D97757.svg)](#快速开始与一键安装) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Windows_%7C_macOS_%7C_Linux-success.svg)](#智能四级防御与自动豁免架构) [English](./README.md) | **简体中文** · [中文更新日志](./CHANGELOG_zh.md)
### ✨ v1.2.0 架构升级（本机用户级许可库与故障关闭加固） 工程豁免许可现独立存放在当前用户的私有目录（`~/.gemini/config/agent-blindfold-grants/`），以工程规范真实路径作为身份标识。新建、续期或撤销许可均不触碰项目文件与 Git 元数据，天然保持普通仓库、链接工作树（worktree）与子模块（submodule）工作区纯净。 Bash 入口需要 Python 3.9 或更新版本，会自动按顺序探测已激活的虚拟环境、PATH 上实际可用的解释器（在 Windows Git Bash 下自动跳过无解释器的 WindowsApps 空别名）及 Windows Python 启动器；若缺失解释器或宿主消息异常，守卫会按故障关闭（Fail-Closed）原则返回宿主可识别的拒绝决策。 **从 v1.1.x 升级已有工程：** 项目目录内遗留的 `.allow_media` 文件将被忽略并保留原样，防止第三方仓库随包夹带“自解锁标记”。需要保留手工授权的工程请核对路径，通过本机控制器（`unlock.ps1` / `unlock.sh` / `blindfold-control.cmd`）重新签发限时或永久许可。默认 `timed` 策略仍会在每次合格工程会话开始时按全局配置自动续签；若希望每个工程都经人工确认，请设为 `off`（已签发的本机许可可单独撤销）。损坏的全局策略文件会自动暂停新签发而非回退为自动放行；状态页统一展示当前进程实际生效的策略、TTL 与环境变量覆盖来源。 --- ## ⚡ 为什么需要 `agent-blindfold`？（隐私保护与防误封护盾） 如今的本地 AI 编程助手（如 **Google Antigravity**、**Claude Code** 等）均具备原生多模态读取能力——一旦 Agent 对本地图片、音视频调用了 `read_file`、`Read` 或多模态 MCP 工具，文件的原始字节流就会瞬间被编码并上传至云端大模型接口。 仅仅依靠在 `GEMINI.md` 或 `CLAUDE.md` 中编写提示词规则，本质上只是一纸**“君子协定”**，而非物理安全边界： 1. **不可逆的个人隐私泄露**：当派发多个子智能体（Subagents）并发扫描目录、或长上下文导致模型注意力衰减时，Agent 极易在遍历目录时误读 `Pictures`、`Downloads`、`Desktop` 或 `AppData`（微信/Telegram/浏览器缓存）中的私人照片、截图或视频。多模态数据一旦上云便不可撤回。 2. **云端风控误判与高价值账号封禁风险（Anti-Ban Shield）**：海外云端大模型接口对上传的视觉素材有着极其严苛的自动化安全审查机制。一旦 Agent 在扫盘时误读了你本地硬盘里的二次元插画（例如《物语系列》忍野忍插画、动漫壁纸、游戏拆包 CG 等），极易触发云端审核模型的误判，直接导致高价值的开发者账号或订阅额度被**无预警封禁**。 **`agent-blindfold`（代号：`Heart-Under-Blade / 刃下心`）v1.2** 提供**“软硬双层零信任防护 + 前端工程无感自动豁免”**： - **第一层：软约束提示词纪律（`rules/AGENTS.md`）**：随插件自动注入，明确划清私人禁区与前端工程沙盒边界，避免无谓消耗 Token。 - **第二层：宿主工具调用守卫（`SessionStart` + `PreToolUse` 双钩子）**：在工程会话启动时自动按策略下发**限时（TTL，默认 `2h`）**或**永久（`permanent`）**媒体豁免通行证，原生自动豁免 `scratch` 工程沙盒、当前会话 `brain` 产物目录、`.playwright-mcp` 网页截图与 `.svg` 矢量代码，并在底层一票否决私人目录访问与 Agent 自解锁篡改行为。 --- ## 🛡️ 智能四级防御与自动豁免架构 ```mermaid flowchart TD S["SessionStart 会话启动钩子
(session_start.ps1 / session_start.sh)"] --> S1{"是否为独立工程工作区?
(自动跳过私人目录与纯聊天只读目录)"} S1 -- "是" --> S2["在用户目录签发工程许可
(可选限时 TTL 默认 2h / 永久放行)
工程与 Git 元数据不变"] A["Agent 发起工具调用
(read_file / Read / Write / MCP / run_command / Bash)"] --> T{"防自解锁护盾 (Anti-Tamper):
是否试图伪造/修改 .allow_media 或策略文件?"} T -- "是 (写入/篡改/调用 unlock)" --> DENYT["🚫 HARD DENY 无条件拦截
(严防 Agent 越权自解锁)"] T -- "否" --> C{"是否触碰受控二进制媒体?
(.jpg/.png/.webp/.heic/.mp4/.mp3...)"} C -- "否 (纯代码 / 公网 https:// / 工作区与沙盒内 .svg)" --> ALLOW["✅ ALLOW 放行 / 无感透传"] C -- "是" --> D{"第一级：是否命中核心私人禁区?
(Pictures / Videos / Music / AppData
或直接将 Desktop / Downloads / Documents 作为根目录)"} D -- "是" --> DENY1["🚫 HARD DENY 永久焊死
(任何标记均不可解锁)"] D -- "否" --> E0{"第零级：是否命中前端/工程沙盒?
(scratch/<子工程> / 当前会话 brain/<id> / .playwright-mcp)"} E0 -- "是 (已通过真实符号链接校验)" --> ALLOW E0 -- "否" --> E{"第二级：是否位于独立的
当前活跃项目工作区内?"} E -- "否 (跨盘符外部路径 / 父目录旁路文件)" --> DENY2["🚫 HARD DENY 无条件拦截
(外部目录物理隔离)"] E -- "是" --> F{"第三级：是否存在有效的本机工程许可?
(永久通行证 或 未过期的限时 TTL 通行证)"} F -- "无 / 已过期 (自动清理回收)" --> DENY3["🔒 DEFAULT DENY 默认拦截
(阻断读取与命令行转码偷看;
放行安全 Git 操作)"] F -- "有效" --> ALLOW ``` ### 监控文件后缀范围 - **图片格式**：`.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png`, `.gif`, `.webp`, `.bmp`, `.ico`, `.heic`, `.heif`, `.avif` *（注：位于独立工程工作区及工程沙盒内部的 `.svg` 纯文本矢量代码自动豁免，确保前端 SVG 编程与图标开发零干扰；个人敏感目录内的 `.svg` 依然严格拦截）。* - **视频格式**：`.mp4`, `.mkv`, `.avi`, `.mov`, `.webm`, `.flv`, `.wmv` - **音频格式**：`.mp3`, `.wav`, `.flac`, `.m4a`, `.ogg`, `.aac` ### 智能四级管控策略 | 防御级别 | 命中范围 | 执行动作 | 实战行为说明 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **第一级：核心私人禁区** | `Pictures`, `Videos`, `Music`, `AppData`，以及直接访问或直接设为工作区的 `Desktop`, `Downloads`, `Documents` | **无条件 `deny`** | 物理焊死——哪怕误把整个 `Downloads` 设为工作区并放入 `.allow_media`、或在沙盒内建符号链接指向 `Pictures`，也绝不放行。 | | **第零级：工程与前端沙盒** | `~/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/<子项目>`、当前对话专属 `brain/<当前会话ID>`、工作区内 `.playwright-mcp/` 截图 | **原生自动豁免 (`allow`)** | 即使未挂载 Active Workspace，在 `scratch` 新建前端项目、生成产物或用 Playwright 截图自检 UI 均自动畅行；同时严密阻断跨会话读取其他窗口的 `.user_uploaded/` 附件。 | | **第二级：外部目录隔离** | 不在当前独立项目工作区（`workspacePaths` / `cwd`）内的任何本地路径 | **无条件 `deny`** | `2h`）或永久本机工程许可；限时到期后自动失效清理，也可设为 `off` 纯手动授权模式。 | ### 内置防绕过与防越权加固 - **防 Agent 自解锁护盾（Anti-Tamper Guard）**：全面拦截 `write_file`、`edit_file`、`Write`、`Edit`、`MultiEdit`、MCP 写文件工具以及终端命令，严禁 AI Agent # 🕶️ agent-blindfold ### *"Keep your AI Agent's eyes on the code, not on your private stash."* **Codename: `Heart-Under-Blade` (`刃下心`) · v1.2.0** [![CI](https://github.com/zanex-dev/agent-blindfold/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/zanex-dev/agent-blindfold/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-gold.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Antigravity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google_Antigravity-Native_Plugin_%26_Hook-4285F4.svg)](#quick-start--one-click-install) [![Claude Code](https://img.shields.io/badge/Claude_Code-SessionStart_%2B_PreToolUse-D97757.svg)](#quick-start--one-click-install) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Windows_%7C_macOS_%7C_Linux-success.svg)](#architecture--smart-4-tier-defense) **English** | [简体中文](./README_zh.md) · [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md)
### ✨ What's New in v1.2.0 (User-Scoped Grants & Fail-Closed Hardening) Workspace grants now live in the current user's private store (`~/.gemini/config/agent-blindfold-grants/`) and use the canonical workspace path as identity. Issuing, renewing, or revoking a grant never modifies project files or Git metadata—cleanly supporting regular repositories, linked worktrees, and submodules without dirtying `git status`. The Unix/Bash hooks require Python 3.9 or newer. They probe the active virtual environment, working executables on `PATH` (skipping empty WindowsApps alias stubs under Git Bash), and the Windows `py` launcher where available; a missing interpreter or malformed hook payload fails closed with a host-compatible blocking response. **Upgrading existing workspaces from v1.1.x:** Legacy in-project `.allow_media` files are now ignored and left intact so untrusted repositories cannot ship pre-unlocked passes. Review each workspace path and use the local controller (`unlock.ps1` / `unlock.sh` / `blindfold-control.cmd`) to reissue any manual timed or permanent grants you want to keep. Default `timed` policy still renews at each eligible session start; set `off` to require manual approval for each new grant. Existing local grants can be revoked individually, and an invalid policy file pauses new automatic issuance rather than falling back to auto-grant. Status output displays the effective settings for the current process along with their sources. --- ## ⚡ Why `agent-blindfold`? (Privacy & Anti-Ban Shield) Modern AI Coding Agents (**Google Antigravity**, **Claude Code**, etc.) are natively multimodal—whenever an agent invokes `read_file`, `Read`, or an MCP inspection tool on a local image, video, or audio file, the raw binary bytes are immediately uploaded to cloud multimodal endpoints. Relying solely on system prompts (`GEMINI.md` / `CLAUDE.md`) is a **gentleman's agreement**, not a security boundary: 1. **Irreversible Privacy Leakage**: During broad directory scans, parallel subagent exploration, or long-context attention decay, an agent can accidentally read personal photos, screen recordings, or cached chat media in `Pictures`, `Downloads`, `Desktop`, or `AppData`. Once transmitted to the cloud, it cannot be undone. 2. **False-Positive Account Bans (Anti-Ban Shield)**: Cloud safety classifiers automatically audit uploaded visual media. If an agent accidentally reads local anime illustrations (e.g., *Monogatari* / Oshino Shinobu artwork), game CGs, or private artwork on your disk, automated cloud moderation can flag your account and trigger an immediate, irreversible **account suspension**. **`agent-blindfold` (`Heart-Under-Blade / 刃下心`)** enforces **Dual-Layer Zero-Trust Protection** without blinding frontend/UI engineering: - **Layer 1 — Soft Prompt Discipline (`rules/AGENTS.md`)**: Instructs the agent upfront to skip personal/external binary media while permitting legitimate UI/frontend verification assets. - **Layer 2 — Host Tool-Call Guard (`SessionStart` + `PreToolUse` Hooks)**: Automatically grants **Timed (TTL)** or **Permanent** workspace passes at the start of engineering sessions, exempts UI sandboxes (`scratch`, `brain`, `.playwright-mcp`, `.svg`), and checks protected media paths and attempted policy changes before covered host tool calls. --- ## 🛡️ Architecture & Smart 4-Tier Defense ```mermaid flowchart TD S["SessionStart Hook
(session_start.ps1 / session_start.sh)"] --> S1{"Engineering Workspace?
(Skips Vaults & Read-Only Chat)"} S1 -- "Yes" --> S2["Issues user-owned workspace grant
(Timed Default 2h OR Permanent)
in private user state"] A["Agent invokes Tool
(read_file / Read / Write / MCP / run_command / Bash)"] --> T{"Anti-Tamper Guard:
Touches .allow_media / policy / unlock.*?"} T -- "Yes (Mutation / Exec)" --> DENYT["🚫 HARD DENY
(Blocks Agent Self-Unlock)"] T -- "No" --> C{"Touches Monitored Media?
(.jpg/.png/.webp/.heic/.mp4/.mp3...)"} C -- "No (Code / Web https:// / Workspace .svg)" --> ALLOW["✅ ALLOW / Neutral Pass-Through"] C -- "Yes" --> D{"Tier 1: In Hard Personal Vault?
(Pictures / Videos / Music / AppData
or Root Desktop / Downloads / Documents)"} D -- "Yes" --> DENY1["🚫 HARD DENY
(Permanently Locked)"] D -- "No" --> E0{"Tier 0: Engineering Sandbox?
(scratch/<app> / active brain/<id> / .playwright-mcp)"} E0 -- "Yes (Symlink-Verified)" --> ALLOW E0 -- "No" --> E{"Tier 2: Inside a Dedicated
Active Project Workspace?"} E -- "No (External Path / Sibling Leak)" --> DENY2["🚫 HARD DENY
(External Directory Isolation)"] E -- "Yes" --> F{"Tier 3: Valid local workspace grant?
(Permanent or Unexpired Timed TTL)"} F -- "No / Expired (Auto-Cleaned)" --> DENY3["🔒 DEFAULT DENY
(Blocks Read & Shell Byte-Dump;
Allows Safe Git Ops)"] F -- "Yes" --> ALLOW ``` ### Monitored Media Extensions - **Images**: `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png`, `.gif`, `.webp`, `.bmp`, `.ico`, `.heic`, `.heif`, `.avif` *(Note: plain-text `.svg` vector icons inside project workspaces and engineering sandboxes are exempted so frontend UI development is never disrupted; `.svg` inside personal vaults remains blocked).* - **Video**: `.mp4`, `.mkv`, `.avi`, `.mov`, `.webm`, `.flv`, `.wmv` - **Audio**: `.mp3`, `.wav`, `.flac`, `.m4a`, `.ogg`, `.aac` ### Smart Four-Tier Policy | Tier | Scope | Policy | Real-World Behavior | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Tier 1: Hard Personal Vaults** | `Pictures`, `Videos`, `Music`, `AppData`, plus root `Desktop`, `Downloads`, `Documents` | **Unconditional `deny`** | Permanently locked—even if `~/Downloads` itself is opened as a workspace or contains `.allow_media`. Evaluated **after** symlink/junction resolution. | | **Tier 0: Engineering Sandboxes** | `~/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/`, active `artifactDirectoryPath` (`brain/`), `/.playwright-mcp/` | **Auto-Exempt (`allow`)** | Keeps frontend/SVG/Playwright UI visual checks working seamlessly even when no Active Workspace is mounted, while blocking cross-session `.user_uploaded/` leaks. | | **Tier 2: External Directories** | Any path outside your active dedicated project workspace (`workspacePaths` / `cwd`) | **Unconditional `deny`** | Blocks cross-drive snooping, `../` traversals, symlinks, and sibling files in parent folders. | | **Tier 3: Dedicated Project Workspace** | Project assets inside a specific repo (including repos cloned under `~/Downloads/my-app` or `~/Desktop/my-app`) | **`SessionStart` Auto-Pass (`timed` / `permanent`) or Manual Pass** | Automatically receives a timed (`2h` default) or permanent local grant at session start (configurable to `off` for strict manual mode); expired passes auto-clean themselves. | ### Built-In Bypass & Anti-Tamper Hardening - **Anti-Tamper Guard (Zero Self-Unlock)**: Intercepts `write_file`, `edit_file`, `Write`, `Edit`, `MultiEdit`, MCP write tools, and terminal commands (`run_command` / `Bash`) so AI Agents can **never** create, edit, forge, or delete local grants (`agent-blindfold-grants/`), legacy `.allow_media` markers, `agent-blindfold.json`, or run `unlock.ps1` / `unlock.sh`. - **Shell / Terminal Guard (`run_command` & `Bash`)**: Blocks directory scans on `Pictures`/`Videos`/`Music`, blocks shell commands touching personal/external media, blocks command-chained `git` spoofing (`git status && base64 a.png`), and blocks content-encoding bypasses (`base64`, `certutil`, `xxd`, `PIL`, `cv2`, `ffmpeg`, `magick`, `tesseract`) on locked workspace media—without breaking `git status`, `git add`, or `git commit`. - **MCP & URI Normalization**: Inspects nested `call_mcp_tool` arguments (`markitdown`, `filesystem`, `playwright`), decodes percent-encoded `file://` URIs (`%20`), strips NTFS `::$DATA` streams, resolves symlinks, and ignores public `https://` web URLs. - **Zero Permission Hijacking on Claude Code**: Exits `0` with **empty `stdout`** when allowing a tool call or `SessionStart` event on Claude Code, deferring cleanly to Claude Code's native permission prompts. - **Windows `cmd /c` Clean Stream**: Writes raw UTF-8 (no BOM) bytes directly to `stdout` and uses quote-free invocation so Windows `CreateProcess` never corrupts `protojson` with `\"` escaping. --- ## 🚀 Quick Start & One-Click Install ### 1. Clone the Repository ```bash git clone https://github.com/zanex-dev/agent-blindfold.git cd agent-blindfold ``` ### 2. One-Click Global Install (Configurable Timed vs. Permanent Auto-Grant) By default, the installer enables **Timed (`2h`)** automatic exemption at `SessionStart` (`~/.gemini/config/agent-blindfold.json`), installs the **Google Antigravity** native plugin (`~/.gemini/config/plugins/agent-blindfold`), and losslessly merges `SessionStart` + `PreToolUse` hooks into **Claude Code** (`~/.claude/settings.json` with `.bak` backup): #### Windows (PowerShell) ```powershell # Default: Timed 2h auto-exemption at session start powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 # Optional: Permanent auto-exemption for engineering workspaces, or 'off' for manual-only powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 -AutoGrant permanent powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 -AutoGrant timed -DefaultTTL 4h ``` #### macOS / Linux (Bash) ```bash chmod +x ./install.sh ./scripts/*.sh ./install.sh # Optional: Permanent auto-exemption or custom TTL ./install.sh --auto-grant permanent ./install.sh --auto-grant timed --ttl 4h ``` ### 3. One-Click Clean Uninstall ```powershell # Windows powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 -Uninstall ``` ```bash # macOS / Linux ./install.sh --uninstall ``` ### 4. Live Toggle in Google Antigravity (Zero Restart) Because `agent-blindfold` ships as a native Antigravity plugin bundle, you can temporarily pause or resume all hooks & rules live—without uninstalling or restarting the app—via **Customizations → Plugins → Agent Blindfold** (or via chat link `customization://agent-blindfold`) whenever debugging or updating the firewall itself. --- ## 🔓 Timed vs. Permanent Workspace Passes (`unlock` CLI & Controller) You can switch global `SessionStart` policy or issue/revoke per-workspace passes at any time from your own terminal (or by double-clicking **`blindfold-control.cmd`** on Windows): ### Windows PowerShell (`scripts/unlock.ps1`) ```powershell # Grant a 2-hour timed pass (expires automatically; stored in the user profile) powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\unlock.ps1 -Mode timed -TTL 2h -Workspace C:\path\to\my-app # Grant a permanent pass to a trusted frontend project powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\unlock.ps1 -Mode permanent -Workspace C:\path\to\my-app # Check current workspace pass & global SessionStart policy powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\unlock.ps1 -Status -Workspace C:\path\to\my-app # Revoke pass immediately (re-lock workspace) powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\unlock.ps1 -Lock -Workspace C:\path\to\my-app # Switch global SessionStart auto-grant policy (timed | permanent | off) powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\unlock.ps1 -GlobalAutoGrant permanent ``` ### macOS / Linux (`scripts/unlock.sh`) ```bash ./scripts/unlock.sh --timed 2h --workspace /path/to/my-app ./scripts/unlock.sh --permanent --workspace /path/to/my-app ./scripts/unlock.sh --status --workspace /path/to/my-app ./scripts/unlock.sh --lock --workspace /path/to/my-app ./scripts/unlock.sh --global-auto-grant permanent ``` ### Rejection Message Language (`AGENT_BLINDFOLD_LANG`) By default, block reasons are emitted in concise **English + Chinese** (`bilingual`). Customize via environment variable: - `AGENT_BLINDFOLD_LANG=en` — English only - `AGENT_BLINDFOLD_LANG=zh` — Simplified Chinese only - `AGENT_BLINDFOLD_LANG=bilingual` — Default (`English | 中文`) --- ## 🧪 Running the Automated Test Suite `agent-blindfold` ships with zero-dependency cross-platform end-to-end security, local grant store, and sandboxed installer test suites (`tests/run_tests.py` and `tests/test_local_grants.py`): ```bash python tests/run_tests.py python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_local_grants.py -v ``` --- ## 📂 Repository Structure ```text agent-blindfold/ ├── .github/workflows/ │ └── ci.yml #
